data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'gode' (God) and 'weard' (guard, protector). The name Goddard signifies 'God's spear', symbolizing divine protection and strength. The name Goddard carries the meaning “God's spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Goddard usually hope their child will grow to embody god's spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
